method: GBIF occurrence records (June 2026 snapshot, all years), keeping records without coordinate-error flags and with coordinate uncertainty ≤ 1 km or unreported. Species are distinct species names; groups follow GBIF taxonomy (plants = kingdom Plantae; fungi includes lichens). Counts measure recorded biodiversity, which tracks observer effort — eBird hotspots and popular parks have many more records — as much as what actually lives there.
